key_finding: AcrVA1 inhibits MbCas12a and Mb3Cas12a as well as AsCas12a and LbCas12a
context: E. coli interference assay; Moraxella and reagent orthologues
confidence_limits: High for inhibition. Heterologous host, not M. bovoculi; no native-pair assay

key_finding: AcrVA1 triggers Cas12a-dependent cleavage within the guide spacer and acts with multiple turnover
confidence_limits: High in vitro. Reagent enzymes at 40.0 % and 32.2 % identity to the enzyme in the acrVA1 strain

key_finding: Structures of AcrVA1 bound to Cas12a-crRNA; PDB 6NMD chain B is A0A5H1ZR47
confidence_limits: High for the complex; does not establish the native partner

claim_tested: acrVA1 sits in a mobile element
key_finding: acrVA1 at 1,623,942-1,624,454 inside a 55.8 kb prophage (1,616,725-1,672,475): tyrosine recombinase 453 bp away, second integrase 147 bp from tRNA-Val, tail/tape-measure/terminase module, GC 43.26 % vs 45.52 % (MWU p=1.3e-16), codon-usage distance elevated (p=1.9e-4)
confidence_limits: Strong prophage call. No convincing att site (longest exact flanking repeat 14 bp, within chance); boundaries approximate

claim_tested: Mobile context is consistent across genomes
key_finding: acrVA1-acrVA2 cassette with an invariant 11 bp gap, in phage neighbourhoods, in GCF_000988605.1, GCF_056854595.1 and GCF_056856035.1
confidence_limits: Replicated but n=3; all from one species, two are draft assemblies

claim_tested: The acrVA1 strain has an active type V-A system targeting the acr-bearing element
key_finding: cas12a AAX09_00210 (1,251 aa) + cas4-like + cas2 + 31-spacer array with the type V-A handle; spacer 16 matches perfectly at 1,629,057 behind PAM 5'-TTTA inside the prophage, 5.1 kb from acrVA1; spacer 19 perfect match at 1,631,222
confidence_limits: Sequence evidence only. cas1 is in a 1,039 bp unannotated gap; no transcription or interference data. Perfect self-targeting with a canonical PAM should be lethal unless something suppresses it

claim_tested: How informative the reagent biochemistry is about the native pair
key_finding: Native Cas12a vs MbCas12a 95.4 %, vs LbCas12a 40.0 %, vs AsCas12a 32.2 %
confidence_limits: Identity does not prove inhibition. MbCas12a inhibition (PMID:30190308) was in E. coli

claim_tested: AcrVA1 co-occurs with Cas12a across genomes
key_finding: Cas12a in 19/27 RefSeq M. bovoculi assemblies; sequence-verified AcrVA1 in 3/27; Fisher OR=3.23, p=0.633
confidence_limits: No power at n=3. NCBI Datasets text search over-counted AcrVA1 by matching AcrVA2; counts corrected by CDS retrieval

key_finding: 3 UniProt members, 3 RefSeq proteins named AcrVA1, all M. bovoculi
confidence_limits: Database naming is conservative; remote homologues may exist unnamed
